shared.name: init
shared.description: Invoke ONLY when user types /aos:init (the slash command, not the bash commands app runtime init or agentic-init) to capture the project context.

shared.name: handoff
shared.description: Invoke ONLY when user types /aos:handoff to close the session with a reviewed handoff, project ledger lines, roadmap changes and scope memory proposals.

shared.name: dynamic-workflow
shared.description: Invoke ONLY when user types /aos:dynamic-workflow with a free-form request that should be decomposed and run as a parallel multi-agent workflow.

shared.name: config
shared.description: Re-render provider configuration for the active session. Use after editing adapter templates, hooks.json, or agents/skills without restarting; give a template name to re-render only that template.

shared.name: compile
shared.description: Compile capability artifacts (agents, skills, commands) from source into provider config dir. Run after modifying agents, skills, or commands.
